title: Bounded coproducts of affine locally finite type schemes stay in the big site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], fix a big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/T)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\mathcal B(T)$ be the set of affine open subschemes of $T$. Let $J$ be a set with $|J|\leq\max\{\aleph_0,|\mathcal B(T)|\}$. For each $j\in J$, let $W_j$ be an affine scheme and let $f_j:W_j\to T$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. An affine scheme means a scheme isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$. The scheme coproduct $W=\coprod_{j\in J}W_j$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with the induced map to $T$, is isomorphic over $T$ to an object of the fixed big fppf site. No flatness, separatedness or finite-presentation assumption on the $f_j$ is required. The empty family is allowed.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type; Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size; Tag 000J, lemma-construct-category, bounded-size closure; Tag 000R, lemma-what-is-in-it, (6). These give the stated affine coproduct bound. The maximum includes aleph_0 to cover the empty family.

proof.text: For each $j$, choose $W_j\cong\operatorname{Spec}A_j$. The spectrum is quasi-compact by lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact (iii), so $W_j$ is quasi-compact: carry any open cover across this homeomorphism and pull back a finite subcover. Apply lem-sfb-qc-lft-scheme-size-bound to $f_j$, whose source is now quasi-compact and which is locally of finite type by hypothesis. With $s$ as defined there, this gives $s(W_j)\leq s(T)$ for every $j$. Only quasi-compactness of the source, not of the morphism, is used.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type; Tag 000R, lemma-what-is-in-it (6), using Tag 000J, lemma-construct-category (2).

proof.text: By lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family, the coprojections give an open covering $W=\bigcup_{j\in J}\iota_j(W_j)$ and the unique induced morphism $f:W\to T$. Each open subscheme is isomorphic to $W_j$, hence has the same size: an isomorphism bijects affine opens and induces isomorphisms of their section rings. Put $\kappa=s(T)$. Its defining maximum gives $\aleph_0\leq\kappa$ and $|\mathcal B(T)|\leq\kappa$, so $|J|\leq\kappa\leq\kappa^{\aleph_0}$ (use constant functions for the last injection). Step 1 also gives $s(\iota_j(W_j))\leq\kappa\leq\kappa^{\aleph_0}$. If $J$ is empty, the stated covering forces $W$ empty; all these inequalities and the empty-cover assertion remain valid.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type; Tag 000R, lemma-what-is-in-it (6), using Tag 000J, lemma-construct-category (2).

proof.text: The fixed big site contains $T$ by the definition of its slice over $T$. Apply lem-sfb-big-site-open-cover-size-closure with base object $T$ and the open covering in step 2. Both required bounds have just been checked, including the empty cover. It yields an object $W_0$ of the chosen category and a scheme isomorphism $e:W_0\cong W$.

source.place: Tag 04T7, lemma-bound-finite-type; Tag 000R, lemma-what-is-in-it (6), using Tag 000J, lemma-construct-category (2).

proof.text: Equip $W_0$ with $f_0=f\circ e$. The chosen category in a big site is full, so $f_0$ is a morphism in it to $T$. Thus $(W_0,f_0)$ is an object of the slice $(\mathit{Sch}/T)_{fppf}$, and $e$ is an isomorphism over $T$ since $f\circ e=f_0$. Object membership imposes no covering condition: the flatness and local finite presentation requirements in def-pc-fppf-site describe covering families. The argument has therefore used none of flatness, separatedness or finite presentation of the maps $f_j$.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04T7 and 000R (6); transport to the slice uses topologies.tex definition-big-small-fppf (021S).

lean.statement: theorem bounded_affine_locallyOfFiniteType_coproduct (code : Scheme.{u} ↪ ZFSet.{u + 1}) (S₀ : Set Scheme.{u}) (α : Ordinal.{u + 1}) (hsite : IsStacksBigSiteCategory code S₀ α) (T : StacksBigSiteCategory code α) (J : Type u) (hJ : Cardinal.mk J ≤ max Cardinal.aleph0 (Cardinal.mk T.obj.affineOpens)) (W : J → Scheme.{u}) [∀ j : J, IsAffine (W j)] (f : ∀ j : J, W j ⟶ T.obj) [∀ j : J, LocallyOfFiniteType (f j)] : ∃ W₀ : Over T, ∃ e : W₀.left.obj ≅ ∐ W, e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc f = W₀.hom.hom
lean.note: Cites the already landed def-sfb-stacks-big-site-category to retain the fixed chosen full category, rather than using all schemes in the ambient universe. Over T is its actual slice category; the displayed isomorphism commutes with the maps to T.
